items:
Big Panda likes the beach life with style. In a newly constructed, custom designed spacious Seacrest home a pleasant few steps to Rosemary restaurants and shops, you will find serenity and comfort. 2 king bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms. 2 queen bedrooms with adjoining balcony and shared bathroom. Keep your kiddos happy on the top floor of the house - a gorgeous suite with plenty of room for play and entertainment, featuring built-in bunks which sleep 6 and, of course, their own bathroom.
A welcoming front porch (with ample room to rock and enjoy the twilight or your morning coffee) greets you as you approach Big Panda from the driveway. Enter the light and airy main floor where your family can enjoy time together, lounging on the spacious and chic living room sectional, dining at the comfy and refined rustic table, kitchen round or at the bar. The kitchen (& grill out back) is fully appointed to accommodate you whether an ambitious gourmet or just fixing a quick meal. The open floor plan with vaulted ceilings means whoever is on chef duty can still engage with the rest of the party. Or maybe you are like Big Panda and want to take a night off from cooking, so enjoy the easy stroll to Rosemary restaurants or Seacrest village restaurants, 100 yards from the house. A few details:
All bedroom windows have blackout shades. All living area windows have sun shades. All bedrooms have flat screen smart TVs and remote control ceiling fans as does the living area. The kids floor has a 60" flat screen smart TV and remote control fans. The home offers wifi and cable TV. Enjoy a spacious driveway which fits 2 large SUVs comfortably and available street parking (the benefits of a corner lot on a closed road outlet). Big Panda is at the most southeastern corner of the Seacrest Beach neighborhood bordering Rosemary. This is a Seacrest property which means you have access to arguably the most beautiful pool on 30A as well as beach access for your entire party. Complimentary tram service to the beach or pool - always helpful with little ones, grandparents, or any lazy pandas, is directly outside the front door. Otherwise walk to the beach 1/3 of a mile away or the pool a few blocks away. Beach chair service and many other amenities are available through vendors. Most services operate March through early November and the majority of Rosemary and Seacrest restaurants are open year round. Big Panda 30A awaits! (disclosure: Big Panda has a security camera active on the front porch)
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
